egress.terms: Not stated as a number on the pricing page. BRIEF §1.1 already records Drime as rclone-native and the cheapest real paid option, so treat egress as the unverified term in this entry.

interface_detail: Web, desktop, mobile, developer API, rclone (BRIEF §1.1: rclone v1.73 native)
tooling: Native rclone backend per BRIEF §1.1 — this is the single reason Drime is on the list at all.
chaining: composition with the pool is unestablished
limits_note: Priced per 'members/workspaces' rather than pure capacity — you are buying a collaboration product with storage attached. Not observed a per-file cap.
reliability_note: European hosting, 20 GB free tier, file history 30-120 days by tier.
